_comment: Shared fixture set for the two real `Gate model:` resolvers that produce a --model argv for claude: tools/gate-model.sh's gate_model_resolve (bash/awk, used by sprint-headless) and cockpit-daemon's gateModel (Go). Both must agree on `expect` for every case. Cross-runtime port, locked by parity per standards/efficiency.md. `parse` is gate_model_parse's raw output; `expect` is the resolved value ("" = no --model flag). NOTE: app.html's parseGateModel is a THIRD reader, display-only for the board's #ck-model chip, and is deliberately not pinned here — it differs on label case (see the case-variant fixture below).
